note: Federal figures the benefits rules are written against. fpl = HHS poverty guidelines by calendar year: [first person, each additional person], annual dollars, for the 48 states and DC, Alaska and Hawaii (aspe.hhs.gov/topics/poverty-economic-mobility/poverty-guidelines, read 2 Oct 2026 for 2026; earlier years from the same series). ssi = SSI federal benefit rate, monthly (ssa.gov/oact/cola/SSI.html; 2026 is the 2.8% COLA on 2025). Update each January; every program whose incomeRule has basis FPL or SSI recomputes from here.
